records.key: Browse the models in spaCR's model zoo, download one and preview with it. The same list the object model settings offer.
records.source: Browse the models in spaCR's model zoo, download one and preview with it. The same list the object model settings offer.
records.translation: 浏览 spaCR 模型库中的模型，下载一个并用它预览。与对象模型设置中提供的列表相同。

records.key: Browse the models in spaCR's model zoo, see what each was trained on, download one and fill in this field. You can still type a path yourself. API: spacr.qt.widgets.model_zoo_picker.choose_model.
records.source: Browse the models in spaCR's model zoo, see what each was trained on, download one and fill in this field. You can still type a path yourself. API: spacr.qt.widgets.model_zoo_picker.choose_model.
records.translation: 浏览 spaCR 模型库中的模型，查看每个模型的训练数据，下载一个并填入此字段。你仍然可以自己输入路径。API：spacr.qt.widgets.model_zoo_picker.choose_model。

records.key: Close the holes inside what was thresholded, before it is labelled. A nucleus dimmer in the middle than at its rim comes back as a ring without this. Otsu detect and the magnifier's Otsu mode both read this box.
records.source: Close the holes inside what was thresholded, before it is labelled. A nucleus dimmer in the middle than at its rim comes back as a ring without this. Otsu detect and the magnifier's Otsu mode both read this box.
records.translation: 在对阈值分割结果编号之前，填充其中的内部孔洞。若细胞核中心比边缘暗，不填充时就会得到环状结果。Otsu detect 和放大镜的 Otsu 模式都遵循此复选框的设置。

records.key: For an ordinary desktop with 16 GB or more. Nothing is cleared at launch or before a run, recent figures stay editable and cached images stay in memory, so returning to them does not load them again, and by default cached data is dropped after 15 minutes unused or above 2048 MB.
records.source: For an ordinary desktop with 16 GB or more. Nothing is cleared at launch or before a run, recent figures stay editable and cached images stay in memory, so returning to them does not load them again, and by default cached data is dropped after 15 minutes unused or above 2048 MB.
records.translation: 适用于内存为 16 GB 或更多的普通台式机。启动时和运行前不清空任何内容，最近的图表保持可编辑，缓存的图像保留在内存中，因此返回时无需重新加载；默认情况下，缓存数据闲置 15 分钟或超过 2048 MB 即被丢弃。

records.key: Gate in switches the plot between 2D and 3D. Z, Voxels, Snap and Spin speed apply only to the 3D view; the merge settings decide how child objects are rolled up when tables are merged.
records.source: Gate in switches the plot between 2D and 3D. Z, Voxels, Snap and Spin speed apply only to the 3D view; the merge settings decide how child objects are rolled up when tables are merged.
records.translation: Gate in 在 2D 和 3D 之间切换绘图。Z、Voxels、Snap 和 Spin speed 仅适用于 3D 视图；合并设置决定合并表格时如何汇总子对象。

records.key: Label (optional)
records.source: Label (optional)
records.translation: 标签（可选）

records.key: Magic wand: how far apart two objects can be and still count as neighbours, in axis-scaled units. The selection grows from the clicked object to every object within this distance of one already selected, so it follows a dense curved population and stops at a wider gap.
records.source: Magic wand: how far apart two objects can be and still count as neighbours, in axis-scaled units. The selection grows from the clicked object to every object within this distance of one already selected, so it follows a dense curved population and stops at a wider gap.
records.translation: 魔棒：两个对象相距多远仍算作相邻，以按坐标轴缩放后的单位计。选区从被点击的对象开始，扩展到与已选对象相距在此距离内的每个对象，因此会沿着密集的弯曲群体延伸，并在更宽的间隙处停止。

records.key: Mask folder for one class
records.source: Mask folder for one class
records.translation: 单个类别的掩膜文件夹

records.key: Model folder
records.source: Model folder
records.translation: 模型文件夹

records.key: New output folder
records.source: New output folder
records.translation: 新输出文件夹

records.key: Overrides (optional)
records.source: Overrides (optional)
records.translation: 覆盖项（可选）

records.key: Read cluster first, so the job can be checked against this cluster's resource limits.
records.source: Read cluster first, so the job can be checked against this cluster's resource limits.
records.translation: 请先“读取集群”，以便根据此集群的资源限制检查该作业。

records.key: Report file or folder
records.source: Report file or folder
records.translation: 报告文件或文件夹

records.key: Resting the pointer on a button, a field or a column header for the chosen Tooltip delay shows a small label saying what it is. The label stays while the pointer is on it and leaves a second after the pointer goes. Cleared, none of these labels appears, and neither does the Tooltips box or the help a hovered setting writes into the bottom strip. The help strips along the bottom of some windows keep showing their text.
records.source: Resting the pointer on a button, a field or a column header for the chosen Tooltip delay shows a small label saying what it is. The label stays while the pointer is on it and leaves a second after the pointer goes. Cleared, none of these labels appears, and neither does the Tooltips box or the help a hovered setting writes into the bottom strip. The help strips along the bottom of some windows keep showing their text.
records.translation: 将指针停留在按钮、字段或列标题上达到所选的工具提示延迟后，会显示一个说明其用途的小标签。指针在标签上时标签保持显示，指针离开一秒后消失。清除后，这些标签都不会出现，工具提示框以及悬停设置时写入底部栏的帮助也不会出现。某些窗口底部的帮助栏仍会显示其文字。

records.key: Run after (optional)
records.source: Run after (optional)
records.translation: 在其后运行（可选）

records.key: Run folder
records.source: Run folder
records.translation: 运行文件夹

records.key: Scale both axes to a common range before clustering. Without it, the axis with the larger numeric range decides the clustering on its own.
records.source: Scale both axes to a common range before clustering. Without it, the axis with the larger numeric range decides the clustering on its own.
records.translation: 聚类之前将两个坐标轴缩放到共同的范围。不缩放时，数值范围较大的坐标轴会单独决定聚类结果。

records.key: Search runs…
records.source: Search runs…
records.translation: 搜索运行…

records.key: Settings file
records.source: Settings file
records.translation: 设置文件

records.key: Stitched folder or .npy
records.source: Stitched folder or .npy
records.translation: 拼接文件夹或 .npy

records.key: Suits cells and nuclei of the kind Cellpose was trained on. It is a trained network that predicts objects from their shape and texture; the other methods here apply fixed rules to intensities and masks. It is slow without a GPU.
records.source: Suits cells and nuclei of the kind Cellpose was trained on. It is a trained network that predicts objects from their shape and texture; the other methods here apply fixed rules to intensities and masks. It is slow without a GPU.
records.translation: 适用于与 Cellpose 训练数据同类的细胞和细胞核。它是一个经过训练的网络，根据形状和纹理预测对象；这里的其他方法则对强度和掩膜应用固定规则。没有 GPU 时速度较慢。

records.key: Template format {version} is newer than this spaCR version reads (it reads formats up to {supported}).
records.source: Template format {version} is newer than this spaCR version reads (it reads formats up to {supported}).
records.translation: 模板格式 {version} 比此版本的 spaCR 所能读取的更新（最多可读取到 {supported} 的格式）。

records.key: The estimator itself and how it is evaluated on held-out data — algorithm, learning rate and regularisation, held-out fraction and cross-validation. Change these when the model overfits, or when the reported accuracy is higher than the data can support.
records.source: The estimator itself and how it is evaluated on held-out data — algorithm, learning rate and regularisation, held-out fraction and cross-validation. Change these when the model overfits, or when the reported accuracy is higher than the data can support.
records.translation: 估计器本身及其在留出数据上的评估方式——算法、学习率和正则化、留出比例以及交叉验证。当模型过拟合，或报告的准确率高于数据所能支持的水平时，请调整这些设置。

records.key: The object everything else is rolled up onto. It decides what a row of the merged table means — rolling cells onto pathogens is also valid and gives a different table.
records.source: The object everything else is rolled up onto. It decides what a row of the merged table means — rolling cells onto pathogens is also valid and gives a different table.
records.translation: 其他所有对象汇总到的对象。它决定合并表格中一行的含义——将细胞汇总到病原体上同样有效，并会得到不同的表格。

records.key: The page behind the figure. Transparent leaves it unpainted, so the figure shows whatever it is placed on, such as a slide.
records.source: The page behind the figure. Transparent leaves it unpainted, so the figure shows whatever it is placed on, such as a slide.
records.translation: 图形背后的页面。选择透明时不绘制底色，图形会显示其所放置位置的底色，例如幻灯片。

records.key: The selected gene's annotation appears here — product, topology, compartment, fitness screens and stage expression.
records.source: The selected gene's annotation appears here — product, topology, compartment, fitness screens and stage expression.
records.translation: 所选基因的注释显示在这里——产物、拓扑结构、亚细胞区室、适应性筛选和各发育阶段的表达。

records.key: The tool a drag uses when nothing else is armed. Default rectangle.
records.source: The tool a drag uses when nothing else is armed. Default rectangle.
records.translation: 当没有启用其他工具时，拖动所使用的工具。默认为矩形。

records.key: measurements.db (optional)
records.source: measurements.db (optional)
records.translation: measurements.db（可选）

records.key: measurements.db or run folder
records.source: measurements.db or run folder
records.translation: measurements.db 或运行文件夹

records.key: {key} is not one of Import's filename conventions.
records.source: {key} is not one of Import's filename conventions.
records.translation: {key} 不是 Import 的文件命名规则之一。

records.key: µm per pixel
records.source: µm per pixel
records.translation: µm 每像素

records.key: ■ Still fitting — {elapsed} so far. This model's fit runs mostly on one CPU core, so one core at 100% and the others idle is expected. Stop is live.
records.source: ■ Still fitting — {elapsed} so far. This model's fit runs mostly on one CPU core, so one core at 100% and the others idle is expected. Stop is live.
records.translation: ■ 仍在拟合 — 目前已用 {elapsed}。此模型的拟合主要在单个 CPU 核心上运行，因此一个核心达到 100% 而其他核心空闲属于正常现象。Stop 可用。
